summary: composer.hint shows a keyboard hint line under the composer (send, new line; the list keys while a completion list is open). ComposerHint renders it in own composers; RichMentionInput reports its list with onListOpenChange.
howTo: Set composer: { hint: true } on AiChatProvider. Texts come from the locale keys composerHintSend, composerHintNewline, composerHintNavigate, composerHintPick and composerHintClose (German in deChatLocale). An own composer on useChatComposerInput renders <ComposerHint completionOpen={composer.completionOpen} />; composer.inputProps already passes onListOpenChange to RichMentionInput. The hint is aria-hidden and hidden on touch devices. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#hint-line.
